title: Claw Maintenance Rituals for Late Spring
description: As we approach the end of spring, it's time to focus on claw health and grooming. This blueprint offers a step-by-step guide to keeping claws sharp and clean during the transitional season.
main_content: Late spring brings humidity and growth, which can affect claw condition. Start by inspecting each claw for cracks or debris. Use a soft brush to remove dirt, then apply a natural oil (like coconut or jojoba) to maintain flexibility. For sharpness, gentle filing with a fine-grit board helps prevent splitting. Finally, let claws air-dry after any cleaning to avoid moisture buildup. Repeat this ritual every three days for optimal results.
key_takeaways: Inspect claws regularly for cracks or debris.
Use natural oils to keep claws flexible.
File gently to maintain sharpness without splitting.
Allow claws to dry completely after cleaning.
